title: Substitute
text: Replace $$x$$ with $$r cos\left(\theta\right)$$ and $$y$$ with $$r sin\left(\theta\right)$$: $$r^2 cos^2\left(\theta\right)-r^2 sin^2\left(\theta\right)=16$$.

title: Use a double-angle identity
text: $$cos^2\left(\theta\right)-sin^2\left(\theta\right)=cos\left(2\theta\right)$$, so $$r^2 cos\left(2\theta\right)=16$$. Divide both sides by $$\cos(2\theta)$$ to get $$r**2=\frac{16}{\cos(2\theta)}$$
